title: Slushie Bar Salts Strawberry Kiwi 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Kiwi by Slushie Bar Salts is a classic flavour duo that offers a harmonious blend of sweet and tart. This e-liquid captures the essence of ripe, juicy Strawberries and pairs it seamlessly with the slightly tart and exotic flavour of Kiwi. The result is a delightful balance of these two popular fruits, creating an e-liquid that's both refreshing and satisfying. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
